ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Conditions for Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Conditions for Swalah.
   B. Apply the teaching of Conditions for Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Conditions for Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Conditions for Swalah has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surahs? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Surahs has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Selected Surahs to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Surahs with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surahs.

   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

7. Which response best shows understanding of Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru? (1 mark)
   A. Use Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru to insult classmates of other faiths.

   D. Say Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru has no place in daily life.

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wudhu.
   C. Use Wudhu to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Wudhu with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character.? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. has no place in daily life.

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Swalah.

13. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

14. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Fitness? (1 mark)

   B. Say Hadith on Fitness has no place in daily life.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels Atid,? (1 mark)
